verdict.rationale: The only evidence touching data portability is the webhook data-forwarding plugin, which gives access to error and project data as BugSnag receives it. That lets you mirror new data elsewhere going forward, but it is not a documented bulk export of existing data, and no open format is stated. The on-premise option (self-managed data) is related to data control but does not itself show an export path. Missing for 10: a documented full or historical data export, explicit open export formats (e.g. JSON/CSV), account-exit or migration guidance, and independent corroboration.
